Privacy policy
App: Bukin Mic Recorder
Developer: bukin
Contact: dev.mechanics998877@gmail.com
Effective date: 2026-10-23

This app records uncompressed WAV audio from USB and built-in microphones. It is not a phone-call recorder.

Summary
• The app records audio only when you start a recording or a Mic Test.
• Recordings are saved as WAV files in the app\'s own storage or in a folder you pick.
• The app has no internet permission, no ads, no analytics and no accounts. It does not send your recordings or other information to the developer or anyone else.
• Recordings leave your phone through this app only when you use Share or Save a copy, or when you pick a cloud-backed folder to save them in. After that, or if you copy files yourself with another app, what happens to them is outside the app\'s control.

Microphone
The app uses the microphone only while you record, during a Mic Test, and briefly when either starts, to find a format your microphone supports. Mic Test audio is processed in memory and is not saved. The app never starts recording on its own.

Recording in the background
A recording you start keeps running when you switch apps or turn the screen off, with an ongoing notification and a Stop button, until you stop it or an error ends it. If notifications are turned off, the app warns you first. Recording still runs, but without the notification.

Where recordings are stored
• App storage (default): Android/data/%1$s/files on your device. Android deletes this folder when you uninstall the app. On Android 10 and earlier, other apps with storage permission may be able to read it.
• A folder you pick: the folder may belong to another app or service, such as cloud storage, which may copy, sync or back up your recordings under its own terms. Files there are kept when you uninstall this app.
The app does not encrypt WAV files.

Keeping and deleting recordings
Recordings are kept until you delete them in the Library, with a file manager or in the folder you picked.

Crash recovery and other app data
While recording, the app keeps a private note of the file it is writing (its name, location and format), so it can repair the file if the app or phone stops unexpectedly. The note is removed once the file is finished or repaired. The app also stores your split interval, the folder you picked, a note about how the last recording ended and whether you have seen the What\'s new note. This stays on your device. The app may write technical messages (such as file names and the microphone\'s name and format) to Android\'s system log on your device, and does not send them anywhere.

Backups and new phones
Android\'s backup and device transfer include only the split interval. They exclude recordings, the folder you picked and crash-recovery data. They don\'t control other backup or sync tools, such as a cloud app holding a folder you picked.

Information shared
The app contains no advertising, analytics, tracking or crash-reporting code, and does not collect, sell or share your personal information. If you install it from Google Play, Google gives the developer statistics such as install counts and, if you agreed to share usage and diagnostics with Google, crash reports. Google processes that data under its own privacy policy.
If you use Send feedback, the app opens your email app with a message to the developer that includes the app version, Android version and phone model. Nothing is sent unless you send it yourself, and the developer uses your message only to reply and to improve the app.

Children
The app is intended for a general audience and is not specifically designed for children.

Visiting this policy webpage
This privacy-policy webpage is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub logs visitor IP addresses for security purposes. This is separate from the app, which does not upload recordings or include analytics.

Changes
If this policy changes, the updated version will be published with a new effective date.
